name: create_tool
description: Creates a new executable custom tool. Self-authoring must be explicitly enabled in configuration, and generated tools always run at DANGEROUS risk. The VM step validates module shape and timeout only; it is not a security sandbox. The body receives args, workspace-jailed fs, path, and console and must return a string. Do not use require, eval, child_process, process APIs, dynamic imports, or Function-constructor access.

name.description: Unique tool name in snake_case, for example count_lines.

description.description: Clear one-sentence description shown to the model.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool arguments: { type: 'object', properties: {...}, required: [...] }.

executeBody.description: JavaScript body of execute(args). It must return a string. Workspace-jailed fs and path are already available.

global.description: If true, stores the tool under global TSUKA_HOME. If false or omitted, stores it under the project-local .tsuka/custom_tools directory.
